name: Piazza Santo Stefano – primo anello
origin: Piazza Santo Stefano road OSM ways 202828108 / 404895528
description: Edifici la cui posizione centrale OSM cade entro 190 m da Piazza Santo Stefano. Ordinati per distanza crescente, a partire dalla chiesa nominata; nessuna facciata residenziale attribuita per supposizione. Foto esterne solo consultate come riferimento, non riprodotte.
next: Secondo anello da 190 m a 320 m: Piazza Santo Stefano, Via Roma e vie contigue

sources.supports: photographic church exterior and urban landscape
brick bell tower with clock; palm trees; cream nearby building; no ID mapping to neighbors

observations.confidence: high for church identity and facade / roof morphology; bell-tower position approximate
observations.facadeAppearance: ivory/cream baroque concave facade, decorative pediment and circular upper oculus
observations.domeAppearance: dark graphite cupola with pale octagonal lantern
observations.towerAppearance: red-brown exposed brick campanile with white circular clock face, beside church, approximate placement
observations.contextAppearance: palms and light stucco neighboring buildings visible; their specific OSM IDs not confirmed
observations.observedFrom: municipal church page; ICCD cultural-heritage photograph; piazza photograph (historic dates unknown)
observations.limitations: Original photo reproduction not stored; perspective facades reconstructed in top-down symbolic art

profiles.note: Unico edificio del primo anello identificato in foto e fonti per nome e posizione. Campanile e cupola documentati; la posizione grafica esatta del campanile è indicativa.
